summary: Iteration 2 — full regression on FishCast enhancements. Backend: 10/10 pytest pass (root, geocode, reverse-geocode, NEW forecast coastal full shape with tide+swell+moon+scene+best_window, NEW forecast inland tide=null/swell=null, NEW AI recommend, AI almanac with moon/tide fields, AI species, spots CRUD, catches CRUD). Frontend: Today screen verified with all 14 expected cards/badges (fishing-score, verdict-badge, scene-summary, best-window, recommendation-card, barometric-card, wind-card, temp-card, moon-card, tide-card, swell-card, sun-card, almanac-card, live-conditions-night_cloudy hero, settings-button, location-pill). Units toggle in Settings modal correctly switches °C↔°F, km/h↔mph, hPa↔inHg across the dashboard. Add-Catch labels reflect units (Weight kg / Length cm in metric). Pick-on-map flow opens map-picker with selected-coords + confirm-pin. Score 73 ('Good') rendered for SF; recommendation card populated by /api/ai/recommend with target/bait/depth/presentation.

issues: Persisting console warnings (cosmetic only): 'shadow*' style props (use boxShadow), 'textShadow*' style props (use textShadow), props.pointerEvents (move to style.pointerEvents). App renders normally.

Leaflet WebView area shows a loading spinner in web preview; selected-coords + confirm-pin are functional, but the actual map tiles did not render via react-native-webview on web in my test window. data-testid="map-webview" was not queryable from outer DOM (likely wrapped as iframe). Likely fine on native, may need verification on web preview if map interaction is required there.

action_items: Optional: verify Leaflet map tiles render inside the WebView on web preview (selected-coords/confirm-pin work, but tiles weren't visible in my screenshot — may just be slow load).
Optional cosmetic: migrate deprecated shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents props to silence RN-web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to ~865 lines — over the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into routers (forecast/ai/spots/catches), services (open_meteo/marine/ephem/scoring), and models modules for maintainability.

compute_best_window uses datetime.fromisoformat on Open-Meteo timezone-aware strings which can be naive without TZ info — falls back gracefully but consider normalizing to aware UTC for consistent comparisons.

extract_tide_data uses datetime.now() (naive) compared to fromisoformat(p['t']) which is also naive (local from Open-Meteo timezone=auto); works because both are naive same-zone but is fragile if data source changes — add an explicit comment or normalize.
AI recommend/almanac fall back to safe defaults on LLM JSON parse failure — good defensive parsing.
MongoDB _id correctly excluded via {"_id":0} projection on list endpoints; spot/catch responses use Pydantic models without _id leakage — verified.
